name: Documentation
title: Templates/Shells/Documentation
summary: The documentation shell: a `GlobalHeader` in its `content` placement (see Templates › Headers › DocsHeader), a `Sidebar` rail from `lg` carrying a `MenuRoot` of the current product’s pages and the theme switcher in its footer, the reading column scrolling inside its own `ScrollArea`, and the “On this page” outline from `xl`. The `Footer` sits INSIDE the reading column’s scroller, in its `content` placement: the bands run full bleed across the zone between the rail and the outline and open on the page boundary, like the top bar above. Below `lg` the rail leaves and the footer takes the whole width; below `md` the footer stacks. The social buttons are small and row two sizes its bands by content, so the brand mark, seven icons and the status pair share one line in a zone as narrow as this column at 1024 wide; the brand leads that row from `lg` (answered by the `lg:` utility, so it follows the breakpoint token) and moves to the signature band below it. Built from `GlobalHeader`, `Sidebar`, `MenuRoot`, `ScrollArea`, `ThemeSwitcher` and `Footer`. Three variants fill the reading column with a real page, built only from the documentation parts: Article is a tutorial (First deploy) — `DocPageHeader` with breadcrumb, last updated and the Copy / View as Markdown and Agent setup actions, then one `DocProse` holding a `DocCardGroup` chooser of paths, `DocCallout` tips, `DocHeading` sections, `DocSteps` with `CodeBlock` commands, a `DocPrompt` for the coding agent, Next steps as `DocCardGroup`, Related resources as `DocItem` rows in a `FrameBox`, then `DocPagination`, with the outline rail as `DocOnThisPage` plus the closing `DocCta`; Reference is a product reference page (an info callout, the request path as a `Diagram` in a `DocFrame`, a JSON `CodeBlock`, a term list); Landing is the documentation home (no outline rail: welcome `DocPageHeader`, Get started, a `DocPrompt`, then `DocCardGroup` entry points by interface, objective, template and follow-along). The variants carry search as a `SearchTrigger` that widens into the ⌘K field.
intents: docs page with steps and code
